key_patterns: 1. Tailwind v4: custom colors/fonts go in @theme block in src/app/globals.css using CSS custom properties like --color-primary: #7656E8; these become bg-primary, text-primary etc. 2. Next.js 16 pages: 'export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{locale: string}> }) { const { locale } = await params; }'. 3. Client components need 'use client' directive at top. 4. Framer Motion: import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion' — works in client components only. 5. All font loading via next/font/google in layout.tsx, applied as CSS variables. 6. localStorage access must be guarded with typeof window !== 'undefined'. 7. Repository pattern: src/lib/repositories/ abstracts data access so swapping localStorage for Supabase only requires changing the repository implementation. 8. i18n: locale param is 'en' or 'fr', translated strings come from src/content/translations/{locale}.ts. 9. lucide-react 1.68 — import icons like: import { BookOpen, Star } from 'lucide-react'. 10. framer-motion 14 uses 'motion' namespace: import { motion } from 'framer-motion'.

directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages and layouts (currently only layout.tsx, page.tsx, globals.css). src/components/ui/ — base UI primitives (Button, Card, Badge, ProgressBar, Modal, Avatar, Spinner, EmptyState, ErrorState). src/components/layout/ — Navbar, Footer, PageShell. src/components/navigation/ — Nav links, mobile menu. src/components/landing/ — Hero, SubjectPreview, HowItWorks, Benefits, CTA sections. src/components/dashboard/ — DashboardWidgets. src/components/subjects/ — SubjectCard, SubjectGrid. src/components/lessons/ — LessonViewer, LessonStep. src/components/quizzes/ — QuizEngine, question type components. src/components/games/ — interactive game components. src/components/achievements/ — Badge, AchievementCard, CelebrationAnimation. src/components/characters/ — SVG mascot components. src/components/shared/ — cross-feature reusable components. src/types/ — all TypeScript interfaces. src/lib/i18n/ — i18n utility and types. src/lib/storage/ — localStorage abstraction. src/lib/repositories/ — repository layer. src/lib/utils/ — general utilities. src/lib/data/ — data loaders. src/hooks/ — custom React hooks. src/features/learning/ — learning flow logic. src/features/quizzes/ — quiz state/engine. src/features/gamification/ — XP/levels/badges. src/features/progress/ — progress tracking. src/features/onboarding/ — wizard state. src/features/profile/ — profile management. src/content/subjects/ — subject and lesson content TypeScript files. src/content/translations/ — en.ts, fr.ts. src/content/challenges/ — daily challenge content. src/config/ — app constants.
